anatomic_site_tumor.evidence: Patients with neurofibromatosis type 2-related schwannomatosis (NF2-SWN) develop hallmark tumors on their vestibular nerves, leading to hearing loss and numerous associated morbidities.

cell_line.evidence: Here we used an immortalized human Schwann cell line, 02.3 2lambda, Control and 3 NF2 KO clones, to perform kinome profiling.
